calibration_policy.fallback: A fitted unit below the minimum reuses the corresponding prior good parameter only when that parameter was fitted under the same method, and the reuse is recorded in candidate metadata. With no compatible prior parameter the candidate fails.
calibration_policy.sample_window: Expanding eligible history through the training cutoff. No event dated on or after the slate date may be used.

cutoff_policy.rule: The training cutoff is derived from the verified rolling state, never supplied by the caller, and must be strictly before the slate date.
cutoff_policy.slate_date_semantics: Step 3B NBA production semantics: America/New_York for a date derived from an offset-aware tip timestamp, and a date-only schedule field preserved verbatim.

dependence_policy.note: The Gaussian copula correlation is a fitted numerical parameter and is re-estimated from eligible pre-cutoff data. The frozen production lambda is then applied unchanged.

gate3_policy.note: Which props receive a role adjustment is frozen. Only the numerical parameters under those frozen routes are refit.

marginal_policy.note: Only the numerical ZINB parameters are re-estimated, using the existing mean-preserving methodology, after mean fitting.

mean_policy.note: Routes are frozen. REB and BLK ensemble weights are daily fitted numerical values. No alternative family is evaluated.

no_new_data_policy.rule: When the derived cutoff and the rolling-state fingerprint both match the parent fit, the information set is unchanged and no fit is produced. An NBA off day mints no duplicate fit_id and changes no promotion state.

oof_policy.rationale: Season-keyed walk-forward is the certified methodology. The expanding time variants split on row position rather than season and are research tools.

promotion.note: Step 3C registers an immutable candidate and stops. Live validation and promotion are Step 3D.

training_window.end: expanding through the verified training cutoff
training_window.fold_count: Not fixed. Season-keyed walk-forward folds grow naturally as seasons become eligible.

purpose: Lock the methodology of the daily adaptive update. It fixes what the nightly job is allowed to do, not what it produces: no fitted value appears here. A daily fit re-estimates numerical parameters under an architecture that was already chosen and certified.

selector_prohibition.enforcement: The forbidden callables are patched to raise for the duration of the fit, and the frozen policy files are hashed before the run and re-verified after every stage. Any change fails the candidate before registration.
